title: Nondegeneracy of normalized rational Verdier evaluation
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l distinct from its characteristic, a separated finite-type D.k-scheme X, a finite extension E of Q_l, coherent integral dualizing data w, and any normalized rational Verdier Datum A as in [def-sf-rational-verdier-data]. For all raw rational constructible objects K,V and maps f,g:V→A.dual(K), equality of tensor(1_K,f) followed by A.evaluation(K) and tensor(1_K,g) followed by that evaluation implies f=g. This is nondegeneracy of the specified localized integral counit, with no scalar embedding, signed swap or bidual comparison involved.

source.place: Paragraph 1, the internal-Hom comparison as the transpose of evaluation; paragraph 3 repeats the same argument for E to L.

proof.text: The fixed-input ordinary adjunction is a linear Hom equivalence; compose its inverse with inverse completion on the constructible pair (K,V). Naturality of completion identifies it with completed tensor followed by the specified integral counit. Its source and target are exactly the full-subcategory Hom groups.

proof.text: Base-change that linear equivalence to the localized coefficient ring. The bilinear pure-tensor formula for rational tensor, the pure-tensor composition law and A.evaluation_integral identify its action on pure tensors with rational evaluation. Additivity extends the equality to sums. The base-changed equivalence is injective; A.objects identifies its source with maps into the supplied rational dual. All raw rational objects have their stored integral objects as representatives.

mathlib_searches.results: IsLocalizedModule.map_injective and generic localization injectivity facts. These do not identify the supplied normalized Verdier evaluation; that identification is the remaining detection step.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Generic linear-localization tools; no exact project normalization theorem.

mathlib_searches.results: LinearEquiv.baseChange, baseChange_tmul and baseChange_symm_tmul. They base-change a supplied linear equivalence; the normalized tensor-Hom equivalence must first be identified.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Useful generic API for the stated proof, no duplicate.

mathlib_searches.results: Generic Mathlib braiding naturality in monoidal categories and localizations. Project search additionally found IntegralVerdierSignedCalculus and EvaluationBidualComparisonTransport, which use native monoidal structures rather than the supplied normalized presentations and raw rational tensors. No standalone theorem of integral scalar interchange for these supplied presentations.

theorem rational_evaluation_detect (A : Datum D l hl X E w)
    (K V : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X)
    (f g : V ⟶ A.dual.obj (op K))
    (h : (tensor D l hl X E).map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 K) f) ≫ A.evaluation K =
      (tensor D l hl X E).map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 K) g) ≫ A.evaluation K) : f = g
